result.summary: The home feed is mostly rendered correctly, but one section heading displays a raw localization key instead of human-readable text. No other clear visual defects were found; the partially visible carousel items and bottom card are expected scroll behavior.

issues.description: The second section heading shows the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a proper title (e.g. 'Popular near you'), directly above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the 'home_feed.popular_title' string key is defined in the active locale's translation file and add a fallback to the default language so raw keys are never displayed to users.
